editor.subtitulo: Explore, edit and organize your project files.
editor.bloqueado_texto:
--- ⏳ FILE LOCKED ---

'{nome}' is being generated/improved by the AI.
Wait until it finishes to edit.
editor.processando_melhorar:
--- ⏳ FILE BEING PROCESSED BY THE AI ---

File: {nome}
Running 'Improve with AI' in the background...
Editing and auto-save are paused.
The document reopens automatically when done.
editor.processando_aventura:
--- 🎲 GENERATING ADVENTURE ---

File: {nome}
The AI is building the 5-room dungeon, statblocks and checks.
Please wait...
editor.processando_conhecimento:
--- 🎲 GENERATING LORE CHECKS ---

Document: {nome}
The AI is calibrating the DC ranges against the lore...
Please wait...
editor.processando_expander:
--- ⏳ RUNNING EXPANDER ---

TODO tag found in '{nome}'.
The AI is expanding the file. Please wait...
editor.conselho_texto:
--- 🏛️ FILE UNDER COUNCIL DELIBERATION ---

File: {nome}
Go to the 'Council' page to deliberate with the specialists.
The document reloads here when done.
editor.ia_melhorar_pergunta:
What should the improvement for '{nome}' achieve?
(Leave blank for a general cohesion and detail pass)
editor.ia_aventura_pergunta:
What is the adventure goal or hook for '{nome}'?
(E.g. hunting a witch in the swamp, a rescue in the catacombs)
editor.ia_conhecimento_pergunta:
Anything specific to focus on for the DCs of '{nome}'?
(E.g. 'Focus on political history and illegal methods' or leave blank)

historico.explicacao: Every time the AI (or a restore) changes the file, the previous version is kept here. Select a version to see its content and click Restore. The current version is kept first too, so you can undo it.

historico.confirmar:
Restore '{nome}' to version v{numero}?

The current version will be kept in the history first.
wb.passo1_texto: Describe the idea or goal (or leave it blank to complete the project from its files). The AI writes the Canon: the official names, facts and secrets. Review and edit the file before generating the plan.
wb.canon_pronto: ✅ Canon: {caminho} — review and edit it freely, then generate the plan.
wb.canon_ausente: No canon yet. Write the idea and click Generate Canon.
wb.toast_canon: ✅ Canon ready! Review it in the Editor.
wb.toast_plano: 📋 Plan ready! Review it before executing.
wb.refazer_canon: This session already has a canon. Generating again replaces the file (the current version goes to the history) and clears the current plan. Continue?
wb.confirmar: Execute {total} checked action(s)? Each one makes AI calls; changed files have their previous version kept in the history.
wb.nova_sessao: Start a new session? The canon and the files already created stay in the project; only the current plan is forgotten.
